details:
> **Q1: What part of this repository should change?**
>
> Choices:
> - **A** — A specific workflow file under `.github/workflows/` — name the workflow/path (RECOMMENDED)
> - **B** — A specific script, prompt, or helper under `scripts/`, `prompts/`, or similar — name the file/path (RECOMMENDED)
> - **C** — A broader pipeline phase (`clarify`, `plan`, `implement`, `review`, `orchestrate`, or `validate`) — name the phase and pair it with a concrete example in Q3
>
> Reply: `Q1: A`
> **Q2: What kind of improvement do you want?**
>
> Choices:
> - **A** — Fix a broken behavior or failing run — describe the current behavior and the expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
> - **B** — Add a missing capability — describe the new behavior you want (RECOMMENDED)
> - **C** — Improve docs/usability/maintainability without changing core behavior — describe what is unclear or painful today
>
> Reply: `Q2: A`
> **Q3: What concrete example should the implementer use as the source of truth?**
>
> Choices:
> - **A** — A GitHub issue, PR, workflow run, or log snippet shows the problem — include the number or link (RECOMMENDED)
> - **B** — The change should target specific file/path(s) — list them (RECOMMENDED)
> - **C** — There is no failing example; success is the exact end state I describe in one sentence
>
> Reply: `Q3: A`
